features.f: A very tall, strong-built woman: broad shoulders, muscular arms and thighs, long legs, a full bust and a defined waist. A long face with a strong square jaw, high cheekbones, a straight nose and full lips; human-shaped ears with a slight point at the top. No horns, tail, fur or scales. Sea Wolf skin is pale sage to grey-green or slate; Hellsguard skin is ashen rose, tan or brick red-brown, and Hellsguard have a dark nose tip.
features.m: A giant of a man, the biggest race: very broad shoulders, a huge barrel chest, a thick neck, tree-trunk arms and legs and big hands, with a head that looks small for the body. A square face with a heavy brow ridge, deep-set eyes, a broad nose and a wide jaw; human-shaped ears with a slight point at the top; often a full beard, moustache or long sideburns. No horns, tail, fur or scales. Sea Wolf skin is pale sage to grey-green or slate; Hellsguard skin is ashen rose, tan or brick red-brown, and Hellsguard have a dark nose tip.

f.desc: A white cropped short-sleeved blouse with a big pointed sailor-style collar (small black cross stitches on the collar points and sleeves) and a silver cross-shaped clasp at the throat, over a black bra-like bodice with a red flame emblem on one side, a white frilled hem and a black bow at the front, leaving the midriff bare. Long puffy black quilted sleeves cover the arms, with brown leather caps at shoulder and elbow and brown cuffs with silver studs; low-slung black leather trousers with silver ornaments at the hips; and black sandals strapped up the bare shins to studded knee guards, with brown soles.

m.desc: A sleeveless black leather harness: a sculpted black breastplate hung from brown leather straps over bare shoulders and upper arms, with silver studs and small silver spikes, a single black plated pauldron on the left shoulder, and an off-white scarf wrapped round the neck. Thick puffy black quilted bracers on the forearms with brown straps at elbow and wrist, a brown studded belt with a big silver knotwork buckle and short side flaps, black leather breeches, and black calf-high boots with silver studs.

notes: HAIR. From XIVAPI CharaMakeType rows 16/17 (Sea Wolf m/f) and 18/19 (Hellsguard m/f), menu 'Hairstyle' (Lobby 234). Its SubMenuParam values are CharaMakeCustomize row ids (m 1301-1386, f 1431-1512), listed here in menu order; both clans have the identical list, so there are no clan-only extras. All 54 m / 48 f have IsPurchasable=false and no HintItem/UnlockLink, so all are free at creation; the aesthetician list (HairMakeType 16/17: 103 m / 99 f) adds the Modern Aesthetics and ceremony styles, which are left out. The Roegadyn originals are m01-m18 (FeatureID 1-13 and 51-55) and f01-f12 (FeatureID 1-12; women have no 13 and no 5x extras). m19-m54 and f13-f48 (FeatureID 102-178) are older aesthetician styles the creator now offers to every race; take only m01-m18 / f01-f12 to match a Lalafell set built from the originals. Variants: m12/m13/m14 are one cut whose small clasp at the back of the crown is gold, white or blue-violet (seen only as a sliver in the front icon; from the front they look the same); m15/m16 are one receding cut with and without a gold-and-red four-pointed jewel on the forehead; m17/m18 one bald-crown cut with and without a red-and-silver jewel. The creator icons are rendered nearly greyscale, so accessory colours come from faint tints and are less certain for: m39/f33's small red band at the end of the nape braid, m13's white clasp, f13's white clip, f19's thin hairband (pale, close to the hair tone; it may be a hair-coloured band). In f44 only one bun shows in the icon (the other is hidden by the angle); the same style on the man (m50) shows two. In game, some accessories may tint with the highlight colour. Icons saved in races/roegadyn-icons (m01_fid1.png ... f48_fid178.png; big/ holds 2x contact sheets). FEATURES. Hellsguard faces have a dark nose tip (all four Hellsguard face icons); Sea Wolf noses are skin-coloured. Male facial-feature options include a full beard, a moustache, scars and white nose/cheek tape; the creator's default men have some switched on (Facial Features InitVal 9 Sea Wolf, 5 Hellsguard, both including bit 1, which on face 1 is the full beard), and the in-game racial-attire screenshot shows a bearded man, so a beard reads as typical but optional.Ears: human-shaped with a slight point at the top. ATTIRE. CharaMakeType Equipment[0] is 131162 (model 90 v2) for both male rows and 131163 (model 91 v2) for both female rows, matching Race 5's RSE items (Roegadyn Harness set / Roegadyn Bodice set); both clans wear the same outfit. Colours from ffxivcollection.com in-game screenshots (black leather, brown straps); the 2013 official renders show the same pieces with a dark olive-black tint. HEIGHT. Community creator-slider chart (vhpg.com, matching the cloudgazers chart): m 213.5-230.4 cm (midpoint 222.0), f 192.0-222.7 cm (midpoint 207.3); scale = midpoint / 90 cm. Lore agrees: men 84-90 ilms, women 75-87 ilms. Not measured in game by me. SKINS. NOTE the brief had the clans reversed: in game the Sea Wolf palette is pale sage and grey-green to slate and dark olive-grey, while the Hellsguard palette is ashen rose, tan and brick red-brown ('reddish hues akin to molten rock', consolegameswiki; the official clan renders show a green-grey Sea Wolf and a red-brown Hellsguard). Swatches are the creator (interface) half of chara/xls/charamake/human.cmp as exported by FlashGalatine/xivdyetools (skin_colors.json, 192 per clan and gender in an 8-column grid, light to dark across each row); not checked against an in-game screenshot. Picks (clan index): m: pale sage green (Sea Wolf default) #D9E3CA = SeaWolf 25, pale ashen rose #D8CBC4 = Hellsguard 1, light moss green #BACF9E = SeaWolf 3, grey sea-green #88A396 = SeaWolf 99, warm tan #99866F = Hellsguard 83, slate grey #6C716D = SeaWolf 165, brick red-brown (Hellsguard default) #865B56 = Hellsguard 172, deep umber #5F4233 = Hellsguard 158; f: pale sage green #D1D8C3 = SeaWolf 25, pale ashen rose #D0C1C0 = Hellsguard 1, soft grey-green (Sea Wolf default) #B6C3AE = SeaWolf 42, grey sea-green #839992 = SeaWolf 83, warm tan #978573 = Hellsguard 67, slate grey #686A69 = SeaWolf 165, brick red-brown (Hellsguard default) #815D51 = Hellsguard 132, deep umber #5A3D31 = Hellsguard 142.
